ModMetaData.name: Fix: WRMegaCorp Quest ExposeData NRE
ModMetaData.author: Meidocho (local patch)
ModMetaData.description: Fixes NullReferenceException in Quest.ExposeData when loading saves with WRMegaCorp's ChoiceLetter_CSC. Root cause: ChoiceLetter_CSC.ExposeData() calls both Scribe_References (via base) and Scribe_Deep on the same quest field. This patch removes the redundant Scribe_Deep.Look call via Harmony Transpiler. See docs/PATCH_Meidocho_WRMegaCorp_QuestExposeData_NRE.md for details.
